6.188 rsWrongNumberOfDataRows
rsWrongNumberOfDataRows is a critical error that will occur if a CustomReportItem.CustomData
element contains a different number of DataRow elements within its DataRows collection than the
number of leaf-node DataGrouping elements within the DataRowGroupings collection. (A leaf-node
DataGrouping element does not contain a child DataGrouping.DataGroupings element.)
